securityNotes: Read SKILL.md, README.md and package.json in full at the pinned commit. No scripts, no network calls, no credential access, no download-and-execute, no hidden or exfiltration-style instructions. The skill only directs the agent to use its own (host-provided) image-generation capability when available; it does not call out to any external service itself.

proposedEntry.name: image-to-code
proposedEntry.description: For visually-important website tasks, directs the agent to generate its own design reference image(s) first, deeply analyze them (text, typography, spacing, buttons, colors, layout logic), and only then implement the frontend to match -- reversing the usual code-first default. Prefers one large, readable image per section over a single compressed multi-section board, requires fresh regeneration instead of cropping when a section needs more detail, and gives concrete hero-cleanliness, anti-nested-box, and anti-AI-slop rules (banned filler copy, banned fake brand names, banned generic gradients) to keep the coded output faithful to the generated references instead of drifting into generic templates.
triggers: build this from a generated design reference
generate then implement this landing page
inputs: a description of the website or section to build
an environment with image-generation capability available to the agent
outputs: one or more generated section-reference images
a deep visual analysis (typography, spacing, color, components) of those images
frontend code implemented to match the generated references

modifications.description: Repository license lives only at repo root (LICENSE), not inside the skill directory. Bundled a copy as LICENSE.txt inside the skill directory so the vendored directory is self-contained.

#### its-thepoe/skills (inspected 2026-08-29)
Pinned HEAD 3172de431451bbad2958b1fd87a79d1ccd39b0e3. image-to-code: read SKILL.md, README.md and package.json in full (single-file skill). Rubric: relevance 2 (design-engineering handoff work, but scoped to marketing/landing-page visual quality specifically), quality 2 (the 38-section structure is extremely repetitive -- the same image-first, don't-crop, and anti-slop rules are restated many times across sections -- but each rule is concrete and actionable, not a prompt dump), conformance 1 (frontmatter and body explicitly and repeatedly say 'Elite website image-to-code skill for Codex' / 'Inside Codex' -- written for one host's image-generation feature rather than host-neutral, which is fixable host coupling per the rubric's conformance-1 tier, not a hard failure since the core instructions still make sense wherever an agent can generate images), uniqueness 2 (extract-static-html and extract-design-md go from existing code to a spec; this is the reverse direction -- generate-image-then-implement -- which nothing else in the registry does). Total 7. License MIT confirmed at repo-root LICENSE, bundled as LICENSE.txt (portability modification). Security: no scripts, no network calls, no hidden instructions; only directs use of the agent's own image-generation capability when available. Verdict: vendor, flagged as the weakest of this repo's five vendored skills due to its Codex-specific framing and repetitive drafting.
